title: Design System: Helm Security Marketing Site

display.purpose: Hero headlines and the largest brand statements only.

headline.purpose: Major section openings and closing calls to action.

title.purpose: Cards, risks, FAQs, and supporting hierarchy.

body.purpose: Scope, evidence, pricing, explanations, and form content.

label.purpose: Compact product names, footer column titles, and concise metadata within established structures; never standalone eyebrow or kicker labels.

shadows.name: pine-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover feedback on an interactive card.

shadows.name: oak-focus
shadows.purpose: Theme-aware focus feedback for form fields and controls.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Field, border, color, and compact control state changes.

motion.name: directional
motion.purpose: Short SVG-arrow travel that confirms direction.

motion.name: first-viewport-reveal
motion.purpose: A single restrained rise for hero content; not for ordinary sections.

motion.name: industry-context
motion.purpose: Slow Aero, Skyline, and Construction scene motion on industry heroes only; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The calm, high-contrast action used for scans, founder contact, and form submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 52px; padding: 0 22px; border: 1px solid light-dark(#17382c,#ead9bc); border-radius: 12px; background: light-dark(#214b3b,#d2b993); color: light-dark(#fffdf7,#132019); font: 650 16px/1 Manrope,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -14px light-dark(rgba(20,48,37,.9),rgba(0,0,0,.92)); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px -14px light-dark(rgba(20,48,37,.95),rgba(0,0,0,.96)); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px light-dark(rgba(156,127,91,.25),rgba(210,185,147,.22)),0 16px 34px -14px light-dark(rgba(20,48,37,.95),rgba(0,0,0,.96)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A quiet paper-surface field with warm-oak focus feedback.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:light-dark(#263129,#e7e9e2); font:600 14px/1.4 Manrope,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width:100%; min-height:52px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:13px 16px; border:1px solid light-dark(rgba(31,41,34,.18),rgba(231,236,229,.17)); border-radius:12px; background:light-dark(#f7f3eb,#18221b); color:light-dark(#16211a,#f7f3ea); font:400 16px/1.4 Manrope,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; outline:none; transition:border-color 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:light-dark(#6a756c,#99a59c); } .ds-field input:hover { border-color:light-dark(rgba(156,127,91,.55),rgba(210,185,147,.48)); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color:light-dark(#9c7f5b,#d2b993); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px light-dark(rgba(156,127,91,.17),rgba(210,185,147,.15)); }

components.name: Elevated Lead Form
components.description: The first-viewport conversion unit: one work-email field and a visibly elevated action.
components.html: <form class="ds-lead-form"><input aria-label="Work email" type="email" placeholder="Work email"><button type="button">Get my free scan</button><small>Plain-English report in about a minute.</small></form>
components.css: .ds-lead-form { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; max-width:620px; font-family:Manrope,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-lead-form input { width:min(340px,100%); min-height:52px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:0 22px; border:1px solid light-dark(rgba(31,41,34,.18),rgba(231,236,229,.17)); border-radius:12px; background:light-dark(#f7f3eb,#18221b); color:light-dark(#16211a,#f7f3ea); font-size:16px; outline:none; transition:border-color 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-lead-form input:focus-visible { border-color:light-dark(#9c7f5b,#d2b993); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px light-dark(rgba(156,127,91,.17),rgba(210,185,147,.15)); } .ds-lead-form button { min-height:52px; padding:0 22px; border:1px solid light-dark(#17382c,#ead9bc); border-radius:12px; background:light-dark(#214b3b,#d2b993); color:light-dark(#fffdf7,#132019); font:650 16px/1 Manrope,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; box-shadow:0 12px 28px -14px light-dark(rgba(20,48,37,.9),rgba(0,0,0,.92)); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-lead-form button:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 16px 34px -14px light-dark(rgba(20,48,37,.95),rgba(0,0,0,.96)); } .ds-lead-form button:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px light-dark(rgba(156,127,91,.25),rgba(210,185,147,.22)); } .ds-lead-form small { flex-basis:100%; color:light-dark(#4d5a50,#b7c1b9); font-size:12px; line-height:1.45; }

components.description: A quiet 72px brand bar with a persistent conversion action and compact secondary links.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-nav { min-height:72px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; padding:0 24px; border-bottom:1px solid light-dark(rgba(31,41,34,.18),rgba(231,236,229,.17)); background:light-dark(rgba(238,233,223,.96),rgba(15,23,18,.96)); font-family:Manrope,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-brand { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; color:light-dark(#214b3b,#d5c6aa); font:400 20px/1 "Tenor Sans","Helvetica Neue",sans-serif; } .ds-nav-brand svg { width:30px; height:30px; } .ds-nav-links { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px; } .ds-nav-links>a { color:light-dark(#4d5a50,#b7c1b9); font-size:13px; font-weight:600; } .ds-nav-links>a:hover,.ds-nav-links>a:focus-visible { color:light-dark(#214b3b,#d5c6aa); } .ds-nav-action { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 18px; border-radius:12px; background:light-dark(#214b3b,#d2b993); color:light-dark(#fffdf7,#132019)!important; } .ds-nav-action:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 4px light-dark(rgba(156,127,91,.17),rgba(210,185,147,.15)); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: A compact informational label for deadlines or pricing terms, never a faux button.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:30px; padding:0 14px; border:1px solid light-dark(rgba(33,75,59,.28),rgba(210,185,147,.4)); border-radius:9999px; background:light-dark(rgba(33,75,59,.07),rgba(210,185,147,.1)); color:light-dark(#214b3b,#d5c6aa); font:700 12px/1.35 Manrope,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; letter-spacing:.02em; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: A restrained paper surface for product and pricing summaries, with lift only when interactive.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-product-card { display:grid; gap:14px; max-width:360px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:32px; border:1px solid light-dark(rgba(31,41,34,.18),rgba(231,236,229,.17)); border-radius:16px; background:light-dark(#f7f3eb,#18221b); color:light-dark(#263129,#e7e9e2); box-shadow:0 18px 42px -36px light-dark(rgba(20,35,27,.38),rgba(0,0,0,.74)); font-family:Manrope,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; transition:transform 320ms cubic-bezier(.2,.65,.25,1),border-color 320ms ease,box-shadow 320ms ease; } .ds-product-card>span { color:light-dark(#214b3b,#d5c6aa); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-product-card h3 { margin:0; color:light-dark(#16211a,#f7f3ea); font-size:22px; line-height:1.2; } .ds-product-card p { margin:0; color:light-dark(#4d5a50,#b7c1b9); line-height:1.6; } .ds-product-card a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; color:light-dark(#214b3b,#d5c6aa); font-size:14px; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; } .ds-product-card a svg { width:1em; height:1em; transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-product-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); border-color:light-dark(#9c7f5b,#d2b993); box-shadow:0 28px 64px -42px light-dark(rgba(33,75,59,.65),rgba(0,0,0,.9)); } .ds-product-card:hover a svg { transform:translateX(4px); } .ds-product-card:focus-within { border-color:light-dark(#9c7f5b,#d2b993); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px light-dark(rgba(156,127,91,.17),rgba(210,185,147,.15)); }

components.name: Ruled Directional Row
components.description: The preferred pattern for services, industries, resources, FAQs, and unnumbered risks.

components.css: .ds-ruled-row { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; padding:28px 8px; border-top:1px solid light-dark(rgba(31,41,34,.18),rgba(231,236,229,.17)); border-bottom:1px solid light-dark(rgba(31,41,34,.18),rgba(231,236,229,.17)); color:light-dark(#16211a,#f7f3ea); font-family:Manrope,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; text-decoration:none; transition:background 260ms ease; } .ds-ruled-row>span { display:grid; gap:8px; } .ds-ruled-row small { color:light-dark(#214b3b,#d5c6aa); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-ruled-row strong { font-size:18px; } .ds-ruled-row>svg { width:20px; height:20px; color:light-dark(#214b3b,#d5c6aa); transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-ruled-row:hover { background:light-dark(rgba(255,255,255,.34),rgba(255,255,255,.045)); } .ds-ruled-row:hover>svg { transform:translateX(4px); } .ds-ruled-row:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px light-dark(#9c7f5b,#d2b993); }

narrative.overview:
Helm should feel like a composed security partner welcoming a business owner into a calm, considered room. The production world is the user-pinned Japandi direction (`user-pinned-japandi-2026-08-04`): mineral paper, deep pine, warm oak, generous breathing room, tactile surfaces, and editorial restraint. It communicates steadiness and care without making security feel soft or vague.

The visual system is persuasive but never theatrical. A left-aligned, high-contrast message and a concrete action anchor the first viewport; candid proof, ruled choices, and published details carry the story afterward. Helm explicitly rejects neon command centers, sci-fi dashboards, fear-driven spectacle, and anonymous enterprise gloss.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet Japanese-modern hospitality with a credible security backbone.
Mineral-paper and deep-pine tonal fields with warm-oak highlights.
Tenor Sans display type paired with precise, readable Manrope.
Ruled lists, asymmetric curves, sparse borders, and restrained lift.
Still, sculptural photography for the homepage and architectural photography for secondary heroes.
Motion concentrated in industry context, with content visible by default everywhere else.
Light and dark themes that preserve the same materials, hierarchy, and contrast.

rules.name: The Material, Not Neon Rule
rules.body: Security is expressed through pine, paper, oak, clarity, and evidence—never electric cyan, matrix grids, glowing command centers, or generic hacker imagery.

rules.name: The Oak Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Warm oak appears as a precise accent or theme counterpart, not a broad decorative wash competing with pine.

rules.name: The Theme Continuity Rule
rules.body: Dark mode changes material values, not the visual identity: hierarchy, legibility, imagery roles, and action contrast remain intact.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Tenor Sans speaks only for the brand and major hierarchy; Manrope does the explanatory, transactional, and evidentiary work.

rules.name: The Calm Display Rule
rules.body: Display type stays regular-weight and tightly composed. Do not simulate authority with heavy, compressed, all-caps headlines.

rules.name: The First-Viewport Rule
rules.body: The first viewport presents one left-aligned, high-contrast message, its explanatory line, and the relevant scan or founder action; imagery supports that decision instead of competing with it.

rules.name: The Ruled-Choice Rule
rules.body: Repeated choices and risks use edge-to-edge hairlines and generous row padding, not floating stacks of lookalike cards. Risk lists remain unnumbered.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A section earns separation through tone, whitespace, or a hairline before it earns a shadow.

rules.name: The Action Gets the Lift Rule
rules.body: Strong elevation belongs to conversion controls, not decorative containers.

rules.name: The One Curve Gesture Rule
rules.body: Use the asymmetric curve as a deliberate focal silhouette, not as a default radius for every card.

rules.name: The Honest Edge Rule
rules.body: Default surfaces use 12–16px rounding; pills belong only to genuinely compact labels and controls.

dos: Do preserve the two-image hierarchy: sculptural homepage, separate architectural secondary hero.
Do lead first viewports with a left-aligned, high-contrast message and one obvious scan or founder action.
Do use Aero, Skyline, and Construction animation only on their matching industry heroes, right-aligned away from the copy, with off-screen pausing and reduced-motion fallbacks.
Do keep section content visible by default and reserve the restrained rise reveal for first-viewport hero content.
Do use ruled, unnumbered rows for risks and SVG arrows for direction.
Do preserve 44px minimum interactive targets, dark-mode continuity, and elevated lead-form button contrast.
Do keep the footer complete, legible, and structurally intact at every breakpoint.
donts: Don't introduce neon, command-center dashboards, hacker clichés, or fear-selling visual effects.
Don't replace candid proof with invented testimonials, badges, customer counts, or outcome claims.
Don't animate ordinary content sections or hide them behind scroll-observer state.
Don't reuse the homepage sculpture as a generic background for every page.
Don't turn every section into a rounded card grid or every label into a pill.
Don't weaken primary lead-form buttons into low-contrast flat fills on elevated or pine backgrounds.
